summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure stands. All 48 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and all five computations reproduced. Figure 3f reports 19 gene ratios from the female BALB/c pilot. The C57BL/6J overlap diagrams give counts without gene identities or directions. No reviewed source supplied signed gene effects for the registered BL/6 hypothalamic Treg diet contrast. The corrected proposal also allows reopening for a demonstrably compatible cohort. [Published figures and methods](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-57918-z)
openIssues: A single library-size adjustment cannot reproduce all 19 published pilot ratios from the deposited counts. Leprot implies a multiplier of 0.281898 and Il7r implies 0.813907. The exact transformation remains unresolved.
